envelope.result: action result, or exactly {reason:code} on refusal
envelope.snapshot: sha256 of canonical {annotation_sha256,sources:[{id,bytes,sha256} sorted by id]}

expand: same fields as query, roots are explicit units, source_scope is sources of roots, whole_source_matches empty, opaque_sources empty. Missing or cyclic reachable dependencies refuse the whole result.
frozen_before_product: Core and adapter do not exist at this freeze. Independent tests have input/admission builders only; behavioral assertions follow this supplement. Public development oracle only.
fts: Optional additional search mode, no literal fallback. Tokenize query with same SQLite unicode61/remove_diacritics0; at most32 tokens. Quoted token AND via parameter binding. Canonical annotation JSON indexing is data, not interpretation. Distinct origin rows merged to unit result. Whole-source rows searched separately. No raw float score exposed.
initial_refusals: RetrievalError(ValueError), fixed code; constructor never returns a partial corpus
matching_details: Unit source origin tests exact unit bytes. Unit annotation origin tests canonical JSON of unit annotations. Whole-source matches independently test full source bytes and canonical JSON of source attributes. Annotation match is never a source quote. sources filters seeds only; closure crosses sources.
metrics: Separate dict of input/setup/index/query counters and timings; never inside canonical response or snapshot. Repeated equal action schedules yield byte-identical semantic responses between arms, not timing equality.

page.units: all unit_metadata of source regardless intersection, same policy both arms
page.utf8: strict UTF8 chunk or null including split codepoint/opaque

query.context_sources: closure source IDs outside requested search scope sorted
query.outcome: EXPAND_COMPLETE if root_units nonempty; else SOURCE_MATCH_NO_DECLARED_UNIT if whole_source_matches; else UNKNOWN_NON_TEXT if scope exclusively opaque; else UNKNOWN_NO_MATCH
query.sources: source_metadata for closure and whole-source hits sorted

request_fields: Closed exactly as initial contract. Unknown fields/schema/action/type refuse. Empty search scopes refused. Empty expand roots refused. No duplicate IDs. Booleans never integers. Search offset bounded to 0..16; values >16 refuse, valid empty final pages allowed. Empty query after ASCII-space splitting refuses; exact phrase remains full nonempty bytes including spaces.

search.opaque_sources: all opaque IDs in search scope sorted
search.unit_matches: paged {id,source,span,sha256,origins} ordered literal ID or FTS bm25/source/unit/origin

trace.comparisons: selected versus each other version sorted: {from,to,bytes_equal,from_span:[prefix,oldend],to_span:[prefix,newend],scope:ONE_CONSERVATIVE_REPLACEMENT_ENCLOSURE}; common prefix then nonoverlapping suffix, equal bytes spans [len,len]
trace.family: nonempty declared string attributes.family_id else null
trace.unit_bindings: same-quote-sha selected-unit/other-version-unit pairs sorted: {left,right,quote_unchanged:true,dependency_ids_changed:boolean,dependency_source_keys_changed:boolean}; dependency source key list consists sorted {unit,source,revision,sha256} or {unit,missing:true}. Equality compares full declared lists, not source truth.
trace.versions: all same declared family source_metadata sorted; if absent, self only

unit_metadata: exact annotation unit record without quote bytes
unit_payload: unit_metadata plus bytes_base64 of full anchored unit
whole_source_matches: sorted list of {source:ID,origins:[source|annotation] sorted}; no invented unit for unannotated bytes or source-attribute match
